about: Plato's Chair inside Muse Glimmer 30B, layer by layer: for each of 35 things, a 2-D map of Muse Image's doodles and people's doodles (Google Quick, Draw!) at each of Glimmer's 52 layers, how spread out each source is, the layer where Muse's doodles collapse and the layer where the word lens reads the name. Derived statistics only. Exploratory. See docs/plato_glimmer.md.
attribution: Human drawings: Google Quick, Draw! dataset (Google Creative Lab), CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/googlecreativelab/quickdraw-dataset

definitions.spread: mean pairwise cosine distance between a concept's pictures at the answer position, on states centered over all 920 pictures (higher = more varied)
definitions.collapse_layer: the first decoder layer (of 52) from which Muse Image's doodles stay less than 0.5 times as spread out as people's drawings of the same thing, through layer 52; null if that never happens
definitions.name_layer: median first layer where the word lens (a logit lens) reads the accepted name, among the pictures Glimmer named correctly
definitions.lens: per picture: the first layer where the word lens reads the accepted name; null when Glimmer did not name the picture correctly
definitions.xy: per layer, the pictures' map positions as x0, y0, x1, y1, ... (Muse Image's doodles first), integers 0-1000 on one square frame shared by every thing and layer
definitions.map: weighted metric MDS (SMACOF) on the chord distances between the pictures' centered, unit-length states (cosine distance = squared chord / 2); pairs within a source weigh 1, across sources 0.2. Layer 1 starts from classical MDS; each later layer starts from the one before with a light pull toward it (0.05) and is rotated onto it (orthogonal Procrustes). The axes have no meaning; distances do.

same_thing_neighbour.what: share of pictures whose nearest picture (same source, leave-one-out, all 35 things) is a picture of the same thing, by layer: how much the state says which thing it is
